_doc: Optional Gmail add-on. Copy to .kb/gmail.json and fill in accounts. Read-only; logins live in each gws config folder, never here. See README > Email.
_keep_header_doc: Optional regex. Always keep a thread if a From/To/Cc/Reply-To header matches, e.g. a client's domain: "clientco\\.com|otherclient\\.io"
_keep_subject_doc: Kept even from bulk senders: a person or biller asking something of you.
keep_subject: sent you a message|follow-?up questions|next steps|interview|schedule a call|book a (call|time)|offer letter|invoice|bill is ready|payment (due|reminder|failed)|overdue|past due|renewal
skip_subject: verification code|verify your|password reset|reset your password|sign-?in code|log-?in code|one-time|security code|2fa|two-factor|2-step|confirm your email|new sign-?in|security alert
_never_store_doc: Threads matching this (subject, sender or body) are never stored. Default walls off legal mail. Set to "" to turn off.
